Why does migration happen?

Migration can occur because economic opportunities differ across locations. Differences in wages, employment, education, public services, and living conditions can create incentives to move.

People also face costs when they migrate. Travel, housing, information, social networks, uncertainty, and family responsibilities can all affect whether a person is able or willing to move.
